extent: at least 6 specifically cited Lovejoy/Elliott-direction documents

component_title: Arthur O. Lovejoy to William E. Dodd, 12 July 1915
notes: Carol S. Gruber cites this exact dated Lovejoy-to-Dodd letter to the Dodd Papers. The current Library of Congress finding aid confirms MSS18697 and General Correspondence but does not expose a Lovejoy child/container in the public index.

repository: University of Oklahoma Libraries Western History Collections
component_title: Lovejoy-Schaper correspondence on the Minnesota dismissal
notes: Gruber cites Arthur O. Lovejoy to Schaper, 4 Dec 1917, and Schaper to Lovejoy, 11 Dec 1917, in the William A. Schaper Collection, Western History Collections, University of Oklahoma Library. Her discussion says Lovejoy was reconstructing what had transpired and quotes Schaper's answer to Lovejoy's question about German success. Current public ArchivesSpace access is robot-blocked, so modern collection identifier and physical container remain unresolved.

component_title: Lovejoy to M. L. Burton on the Schaper case
notes: Gruber cites Lovejoy to M. L. Burton dated 8 Nov, 4 Dec and 18 Dec 1917 in the Minnesota Presidents' Papers. The historical collection title is secure from her archival bibliography and notes, but the modern series/call number and physical containers have not yet been recovered from the current public interface.
